scope: Independent G1K backup branch and its release assets
rules: Excluded private-key and credential file paths, Git object/config directories, virtual environments, and opaque source archives
Scanned recognized text formats for GitHub, Hugging Face, API token and private-key patterns plus credential assignments

residual_risk: Heuristic scanning is not a guarantee that every possible secret encoding is detected. Upstream terms remain applicable.
